content.comment_body: Good morning forum, I'm programming with a [product_name] [article_no] currently and I've run into an issue: halfway through my project (about 10 lines), I can't add any more code. Does [product_name] have a specific limit to the amount of code you can write? Thank you in advance

Since you're writing lines, I assume you're using ladder diagram programming. By default, the LSC setting applies to sheets in your chart. You can change it, but this default is generally comfortable for most users.

Thank you for your reply. Yes, I'm using ladder format. After posting my question, I noticed four squares labeled 1,2,3,4 at the top of the screen—that's where you can add more pages to your project. I appreciate your quick response. Thank you and have a nice day.
Hello [user_name], Thank you for your feedback and rating. Happy to help.

analysis.insight_summary: The user initially thought there was a code line limitation with a [product_name] when programming in ladder diagram mode, but discovered that more pages could be added using interface controls previously overlooked. This experience points to a usability issue regarding how page and code expansion features are presented or explained in the programming environment interface.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects a seamless experience in extending their code, and clearer guidance or notifications when reaching programming limits or when additional features, such as page expansion, are available within the software.
